title: SpoolSpot filament
description: A filament is manufacturer, type and colour; a spool and its filament are one thing for ordering (ADR-0006). The tenant is implied by the caller and is never part of the document. Licensed CC0-1.0 (see REUSE.toml).

spool_kind.description: refillable spools can be refilled from spoolless packs; disposable spools are tossed when empty.

reorder_level.description: How heavily the filament is used. A choice the user makes (or the automatic level makes), never a measurement. Sets the reorder threshold (ADR-0006).

auto_level.description: When true, the level adjusts automatically. Off by default; choosing a level by hand turns it off.
